<!--
How to use this template

- One `##` per referee, one `###` per comment.
- Quote the referee VERBATIM. Never paraphrase a comment you are answering —
  an editor reads this letter beside the original report.
- Every response names where the change landed: section, table, or figure, by
  cross-reference (`@sec-results`, `@tbl-main`), never a hardcoded page number.
  Page numbers move; anchors do not.
- Severity (FATAL / ADDRESSABLE / TASTE) is recorded in the tracker, not shown
  to the referee. Never tell a referee their comment was classified TASTE.
-->

[Brief overview of the major revisions, in the order a reader meets them.
